campaign_logline: A broke pilot must navigate the shifting trade routes between three warring factions.
campaign_pitch: Navigate a dying economic zone. Survive the pirate raids and secure your own fuel supply.
campaign_story_summary: The Zenith corporation faces resource shortages. The Aurelia Collective demands more territory. The Vanguard militia guards the border. You are just trying to survive.

opening.status_quo: Trade routes are failing due to heavy pirate activity.
opening.visible_crisis: The Zenith corporation is losing supply lines and desperate for resources.
opening.hidden_crisis: A massive industrial collapse in the core systems is forcing a migration of wealth.
opening.why_now: Fuel prices have spiked, making independent survival nearly impossible.
opening.player_role: An independent pilot with an aging ship and empty pockets.

mystery.question: Why are the pirates so aggressive now?
mystery.false_answer: They are just desperate scavengers looking for scraps.
mystery.true_answer_hint: The pirate routes follow a specific, planned pattern of destruction.
mystery.long_term_reveal_direction: A corporate conspiracy to create artificial scarcity.

kaelen.public_role: Broker and fixer for independent pilots.
kaelen.secret_angle: She monitors the movement of cargo that shouldn't exist.
kaelen.address_rule: Always refer to her as a broker or fixer.
kaelen.never_reveal_rule: Never reveal her origin, true name, or any special abilities.

factions.zenith_problem: Zenith is running out of refined fuel and needs new sources.
factions.aurelia_problem: Aurelia wants to expand their territory into the contested zones.
factions.vanguard_problem: The Vanguard are struggling to hold the line against pirate incursions.
factions.conflict_triangle: Zenith wants resources, Aurelia wants land, and Vanguard must defend it.
factions.neutral_space_pressure: Independent pilots are being squeezed out of the lucrative trade routes.

act_1.name: The Scavenger's Path
act_1.goal: Establish a foothold in the local sector.
act_1.opening_incident: A cargo ship is intercepted by a pirate vessel.
act_1.midpoint_turn: You find a shipment of high-grade minerals that both Zenith and Aurelia want.
act_1.finale: You must choose which faction to deliver the materials to.
act_1.player_takeaway: The local economy is fractured, and every choice has a cost.

starter_mission.title: The Lone Raider
starter_mission.reason: A pirate ship is harassing trade routes near your home port.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: It thinks you are an easy target for scrap metal.
starter_mission.aftershock_reason: The local authorities will notice the pirate's destruction.

recurring_clue.name: Ghost Signals
recurring_clue.signal: A rhythmic pulse of data packets on a 10hz frequency.
recurring_clue.first_appearance: Detected during your first mission to clear the path.
recurring_clue.escalation: The signal appears more frequently near high-value cargo.
recurring_clue.payoff_hint: The signals are linked to an automated mining network.

rumor_trail.name: The Ghost Mine
rumor_trail.hint_theme: Whispers of a massive, abandoned mine.
clue_templates: A local trader mentions an old mining site.
A derelict ship's log warns of heavy radiation.
rumor_trail.payoff: Unlocks access to a high-value, hidden mineral zone.

horizon.gate_tease: The gate leads to a realm of uncharted territory and new resources.
horizon.new_system_reveal_rule: New systems are revealed only when the player reaches the nearest gate.
horizon.future_faction_tease: Rumors of a nomadic tribe that controls the trade routes.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tease: There is talk of being able to find more advanced alloys.

regeneration_trigger.description: When the main arc of Act 1 is complete, a new gate's path is teased.

rules.fallback_rule: If no story content is available, use a generic trade mission.

story_questions_for_future_generation: What are the pirate ships' names?
Why is the core system experiencing a collapse?
How many ships in the vanguard to be hired as mercs?
Who is behind the organization that tracks the rumors?
Where is the turn point for the next campaign?
